item.title: Sal Buscema, Legendary SPECTACULAR SPIDER-MAN Artist, Has Passed Away Age 89
item.description: Comic book artist Sal Buscema, the legendary artist best known for his work on The Incredible Hulk and Spectacular Spider-Man, passed away just a couple of days before his 90th birthday.

item.title: Ryan Reynolds Prioritises DEADPOOL 4 Amid Wife Blake Lively's Legal Drama
item.description: A new report reveals that Ryan Reynolds is focused on the next Deadpool movie amid the continued legal drama surrounding wife Blake Lively's battle with Justin Baldoni.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor Reveals Which Earth Steve Rogers Is Currently On - SPOILERS
item.description: An intriguing Avengers: Doomsday rumour claims to reveal which alternate reality Chris Evans' Steve Rogers currently calls home with Peggy Carter and their child.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE Action Figures Reveal First Official Look At Tri-Klops, Skeletor Artwork, More
item.description: The first Masters of the Universe action figures feature a first look at Tri-Klops, along with Man-At-Arms, Evil-Lyn, He-Man, and Jared Leto's villainous Skeletor.

item.title: RUMOR: DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN Season 3 Villain Revealed; X-MEN Filming Start Date
item.description: According to some new MCU rumours, Daredevil: Born Again will have at least one villain in common with Spider-Man: Brand New Day. We also have an update on the X-Men reboot.

item.title: STAR WARS: STARFIGHTER Writer Talks Lightsabers And Deciding NOT To Include "Legacy Characters"
item.description: Jonathan Tropper, the writer behind Shawn Levy's Star Wars: Starfighter, discusses lightsabers being part of the movie and the decision not to feature any "legacy characters."

item.title: WONDER MAN Ending Explained: A Shocking Return And Simon Williams' MCU Future - SPOILERS
item.description: We're taking a deep dive into the Wonder Man finale to bring you everything you need to know about how the series ends and what that means for Simon Williams in the MCU moving forward.

item.title: WONDER MAN Links Simon Williams' Powers To A Superhero Team (But Not THE AVENGERS) - SPOILERS
item.description: In the comics, Simon Williams is closely tied to The Avengers and West Coast Avengers. However, the MCU version might have more in common with another superhero team.
